questions.stem: Why does the spongy mesophyll layer have large air spaces between its cells?

options.text: To store water absorbed from the roots
To allow gases to diffuse easily to and from cells
To provide structural support for the leaf
To trap heat energy for photosynthesis

questions.explanation: The air spaces in the spongy mesophyll allow carbon dioxide and oxygen to diffuse easily between the stomata and the photosynthesising cells, increasing the efficiency of gas exchange.
